description: An OmniTool Agent that autonomously performs tasks and makes decisions by leveraging tools like calculators for numerical computations, PDF viewers for document analysis, search engines and web browsers for real-time internet data, and Wikipedia for structured knowledge access—enabling efficient handling of complex queries, research, and data-driven calculations with accurate, contextually relevant results.

tools.name: Calculator
tools.description: A tool for performing numerical calculations, allowing the agent to solve mathematical problems and perform data analysis.

tools.name: PDFViewer
tools.description: A tool for viewing and analyzing PDF documents, enabling the agent to extract and process information from files.

tools.name: SearchEngine
tools.description: A tool for querying web search engines to retrieve real-time information and data from the internet, enhancing the agent's ability to answer complex questions.

tools.name: WebBrowser
tools.description: A tool that allows the agent to browse the web, interact with web pages, and gather data from various online sources.

tools.name: Wikipedia
tools.description: A tool for accessing structured knowledge from Wikipedia, enabling the agent to provide accurate and contextual information on a wide range of topics.
